limitations: Tests cover alpha-renamed generic interface bodies on supported classes, interfaces and objects, substituted classifier parameters, and erased reference/primitive bridges. Recursive/dependent method bounds, interface defaults with default arguments or generic varargs, and generic nested classifiers remain explicit boundaries. No full-app or Android compatibility claim.
